mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.grade, t.week_start, t.status, t.current_version_id, cv.version AS current_version, t.published_version_id, pv.version AS published_version, t.review_version_id, rv.version AS review_version, t.created_by, t.published_at, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM weekly_theme t JOIN weekly_theme_version cv ON cv.id = t.current_version_id LEFT JOIN weekly_theme_version pv ON pv.id = t.published_version_id LEFT JOIN weekly_theme_version rv ON rv.id = t.review_version_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE OF t
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme WHERE grade = #{grade} AND week_start = #{weekStart} AND status = 'PUBLISHED')
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme WHERE id <> #{id} AND grade = #{grade} AND week_start = #{weekStart} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' )

SELECT d.day_of_week, d.mission_id, v.title, v.thinking_type, d.clue, d.rules_out, d.dialogue, d.hint_spots, d.video_uri, v.scene_uri FROM weekly_theme_day d JOIN mission m ON m.id = d.mission_id JOIN mission_version v ON v.id = COALESCE(m.published_version_id, m.current_version_id) WHERE d.theme_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY d.day_of_week
SELECT count(*) FROM mission WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weekly_theme (id, grade, week_start, status, current_version_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{grade}, #{weekStart}, #{status}, #{versionId}, #{createdBy}, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO weekly_theme_version (id, theme_id, version, title, intro, outro, intro_image_uri, outro_image_uri, intro_video_uri, outro_video_uri, intro_motion, outro_motion, big_question, candidates, answer, answer_clue, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{themeId}, #{version}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{story.outro}, #{story.introImageUri}, #{story.outroImageUri}, #{story.introVideoUri}, #{story.outroVideoUri}, #{story.introMotion,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.MotionTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{story.outroMotion,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.MotionTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{story.bigQuestion}, #{story.candidates,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.StringListTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{story.answer}, #{story.answerClue}, #{createdBy}, #{now})

INSERT INTO weekly_theme_day (theme_version_id, day_of_week, mission_id, clue, rules_out, dialogue, hint_spots, video_uri) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{day.missionId}, #{day.clue}, #{day.rulesOut,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.mission.repository.StringListTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{day.dialogue,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.theme.repository.DialogueListTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{day.hintSpots,typeHandler=com.sagomungchi.learning.theme.repository.HintSpotListTypeHandler,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{day.videoUri})
mapper.update: UPDATE weekly_theme SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE weekly_theme SET status = #{status}, review_version_id = current_version_id, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, mission_id, theme_id, context, status, started_at, finished_at, completed_at FROM attempt WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND theme_week_start = #{weekStart} ORDER BY started_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_review_view (student_id, week_start, theme_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{weekStart}, #{themeId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (student_id, week_start) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT kind FROM theme_story_view WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND week_start = #{weekStart}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_story_view (student_id, week_start, kind, theme_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{weekStart}, #{kind}, #{themeId}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (student_id, week_start, kind) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT mission_id, pick, correct, picked_at FROM theme_answer_pick WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND week_start = #{weekStart}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme_day d JOIN weekly_theme_version v ON v.id = d.theme_version_id WHERE d.mission_id = #{missionId} AND d.day_of_week = 5 AND v.big_question IS NOT NULL AND v.answer IS NOT NULL )
SELECT week_start FROM theme_answer_pick WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO theme_answer_pick (student_id, week_start, theme_id, mission_id, pick, correct, picked_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{weekStart}, #{themeId}, #{missionId}, #{pick}, #{correct}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (student_id, week_start) DO NOTHING
